data.narrative:
Arena AI is a Series B defense and security company founded by Pratap Ranade and Engin Ural that has raised $62M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies spanning the Defense & Security sector: two public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms at equivalent or similar stages.

Two primary valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, which uses total capital raised as a baseline proxy and applies a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, implies a valuation of $118M. Peer-median methodology triangulates across seven same-sector, same-stage comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—yielding a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $100M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $559M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression anchors to capital efficiency, while peer-median is sensitive to outlier valuations, particularly Dream Security's $3.0B, which skews the comparable set upward. Key variables affecting the ultimate valuation include Arena AI's revenue traction, customer concentration in the defense sector, and whether near-term funding events occur at valuations closer to early-stage capital efficiency or late-stage peer multiples.
